contribution: A cross-contract, denominator-aware assessment of failure semantics in LEED spot-tracking measurement chains.
thesis_statement: In the tested principal energy scans, LEED spot observability and the interpretation of continuous tracker output depend on the measurement contract: a continuation can remain measurable yet disagree with the predeclared radial branch, agree with the mapped indexed native target, meet the definition of Cross-contract target inconsistency, or remain an Unresolved cross-contract outcome. Robustness therefore requires cross-contract, denominator-aware assessment of both continuity and physical consistency.
working_title: Continuity is not consistency: Cross-contract observability in LEED spot measurement chains
